entries.notes: Embedded/CLI table/query-to-file CSV/Parquet, CLI CSV stdin/stdout, and application-owned Rust/Python CSV streams are implemented. File output uses atomic replacement; JSON is rejected explicitly; HTTP/gRPC reject COPY rather than exposing server paths or process stdio. PostgreSQL wire-level COPY remains a known divergence.
Functional parity is implemented; the fixed SQL performance fixture remains outside the compatibility budget.
